name: fossel-edges-v1
description: Edge-traversal eval (#65). Each query has a strong lexical hit and a second relevant memory that shares few query terms but is one typed edge away from that hit. Plain FTS finds the lexical anchor but misses the neighbour; a one-hop edge leg should recover it. Recall@k is the metric that moves. Edges use the same typed schema as production (keyed by memory id, symmetric types ordered).

memories.note: Login returned a 500 when the session cookie was missing the SameSite attribute.
Set SameSite=Lax on every auth cookie in the response middleware.
Checkout intermittently timed out under load on the payment confirmation step.
Added an idempotency key to the charge call so retries do not double-bill.
Product search was slow because the query did a full table scan.
Created a GIN index to back the catalogue lookups.
Avatar upload crashed the worker on files over the configured size ceiling.
Switched the multipart handler to a streaming parser to bound memory use.
The style guide mandates Tailwind utility classes over bespoke CSS.
Feature flags are read from the config service at request time.

queries.rationale: m-login-bug matches lexically; m-samesite-fix is the fix one hop away and shares little query vocabulary.

queries.query: checkout timed out on payment confirmation under load
queries.rationale: m-pay-timeout matches; m-idempotency is the linked decision with almost no shared terms.

queries.rationale: m-search-slow matches; m-gin-index is the linked fix.
